audit_scope.description: Trust model for EIP-8 (RLPx forward compatibility), Cancun comparison opcodes, Prague transaction types, EIP-7919 (proof-based RPC), and EIP-7199 (linter governance).
in_scope: RLPx handshake forward compatibility and peer discovery (EIP-8)
Prague fork transaction type validation and processing
EIP-7919 proof-based RPC with Merkle proof verification
out_of_scope: EIP-7199 linter governance (meta-governance EIP with no runtime protocol impact)

misclassified_entities.reason: Transaction execution is an internal EVM process, not an external entity.
EIP contributors are governance participants in the linting process, not protocol-level external entities. EIP-7199 is a meta-governance EIP.
misclassified_entities.correct_classification: Governance entity (out of scope for protocol trust model)

trusted_external_entities.name: Peer Initiator
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Peers initiating RLPx handshakes are unauthenticated until the ECIES encryption handshake completes; malformed handshake messages must be tolerated per EIP-8.

trusted_external_entities.name: Remote Peer
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Remote peers are unauthenticated P2P participants; EIP-8 requires accepting future handshake format variations.

trusted_external_entities.name: Discovery Peer
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Discovery peers communicate over unauthenticated UDP; discovery packets may be forged or malformed.

trusted_external_entities.name: Transaction Submitter
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Transaction submitters for Prague-typed transactions are unauthenticated; new transaction type envelopes must be validated.

trusted_external_entities.name: Transaction Signer
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Transaction signers provide ECDSA signatures that must be cryptographically verified; trust is established by signature validity, not identity.

trusted_external_entities.name: RPC Provider
trusted_external_entities.rationale: RPC providers in EIP-7919 serve state data with Merkle proofs; the proof verification eliminates need for trust in the provider.

trusted_external_entities.name: User (EIP-7919)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Users requesting proof-based RPC responses are unauthenticated external consumers.

trusted_external_entities.name: Light Client
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Light clients consuming proof-based responses are external verifiers; they verify proofs against known state roots.

boundary_edges.data_crossing_boundary: ECIES encrypted handshake messages with variable-length padding (EIP-8 format)
RLPx protocol messages with forward-compatible encoding
Discovery packets (ping, pong, findnode, neighbors) with EIP-8 padding
ECDSA signatures (v, r, s) over transaction hash
State data accompanied by Merkle proofs for trustless verification
boundary_edges.trust_boundary: Network boundary - untrusted but verifiable via proofs

gaps: Cancun comparison opcodes are purely internal EVM operations with no external entity interactions.
EIP-7199 is a governance-only EIP; its external entity (EIP contributor) has no protocol-level trust boundary.
EXT-TX-EXECUTION in EIP-7919 was misclassified as external when it is the internal EVM execution engine.
